title: National Investigation Agency v. Zahoor Ahmad Shah Watali

content.caseIdentity: National Investigation Agency v. Zahoor Ahmad Shah Watali, (2019) 5 SCC 1
content.holding: Held that in anti-terror prosecutions under UAPA, the court cannot engage in a mini-trial or evaluate probative weight at the bail stage; bail must be refused if the prosecution material, taken at face value, establishes a prima facie case. This highlights the procedural contrast with Section 113 BNS bail under the BNSS.
content.relevance: Lead precedent contrasting the stringent UAPA bail standard with regular Section 113 BNS bail adjudications.
